8..  Public  Comment  This was the time set aside for anyone wishing to address the City Council on
  items  not  listed  in any  other  place  on  the  agenda.  Mayor Kendrick called for
  public  comment.

  Pam Berry, La Verne resident stated that there was no protest in front of
  Chase' s restaurant.  It was a peaceful assembly in support of Council Member
  Hepburn  for Mayor.

  Jeff Bassler, La Verne resident asked that the City Council reconsider painting
  bike lanes green due to the danger it poses to cyclists and motorcycle riders.

  Keith Jones, La Verne resident commended the La Verne Police Department
  for assisting a homeless man when he called.

  Mark Gutierrez, La Verne Police Officers' Association urged residents to vote
  Yes on Measure LV to maintain and continue the great police service.
